newsitem.title: USA: World Bank releases $80 mln Romania loan tranche.
newsitem.headline: World Bank releases $80 mln Romania loan tranche.

text.p: The World Bank has told Romania that it can draw down an $80 million tranche of an existing $280 million Financial and Enterprise Structural Adjustment Loan (FESAL), Bank officials said on Tuesday.
"The (Bank) board had no objections," one official said. "The tranche can be released."

The board allowed the loan to go ahead after Romania met certain economic conditions laid down in the credit pact. The Bank disbursed $100 million of the loan last year. The final $100 million tranche is expected to be released around the end of this year, after Romania meets additional conditions.
